title: pilosella cymiflora
intro: Pilosella cymiflora, commonly known as Alpine Mouse-Ear, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can help soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune response and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella cymiflora include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
